name: Critical Effects (DH2): Energy - Leg
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-10 (p. 235). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Cannot use the Run or Charge actions for 2 rounds.
Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer 1 level of Fatigue.
1 level of Fatigue and knocked Prone. Movement halved (rounding up) for [[1d10]] rounds.
Movement halved (rounding up) and no Run or Charge actions, until medical attention.
1 level of Fatigue and knocked Prone. Movement halved (rounding up) for [[2d10]] rounds.
2 levels of Fatigue. Challenging (+0) Toughness test: on a success Movement is halved (rounding up) until medical attention, on a failure he gains the Lost Foot condition.
[[1d5]] levels of Fatigue. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round. Gains the Lost Leg condition.
[[1d10]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round. Gains the Lost Leg condition.
